translations.web: The dead bodies of this people will be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth. No one will frighten them away.
translations.bsb: The corpses of this people will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to scare them away.
translations.kjv: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.
translations.asv: And the dead bodies of this people shall be food for the birds of the heavens, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall frighten them away.
